collection.description: A villager sees an unfamiliar expression in their reflection in still water.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A villager sees an unfamiliar expression in their reflection in still water.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They practice changing their face and realize how little they notice themselves.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Ripples distort the image in unexpected ways.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They remember a deceased relative with a similar expression.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: They repeat the observation under different light and angles.

r1.name: Resolution 1
r1.text: The villager discovers a plausible ordinary cause but may still value the experience for personal reasons.

text_only.reason: a memory of what happened, not a skill's experience: nothing is gained

r2.name: Resolution 2
r2.text: A second witness or unexpected detail complicates the simplest explanation.

r3.name: Resolution 3
r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
